```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
```

yaml:
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
